top_findings.title: No MCP protocol implementation — plain in-memory Go library, not an MCP server
top_findings.evidence: grep -rniE 'mark3labs|jsonrpc|register.?tool|add.?tool|serve.?stdio|mcp.New' over all .go files returns zero hits; go.mod:5 declares github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go v0.57.0 but it is never imported. server/server.go:12 MCPServer is a plain struct of ~30 direct method calls with no JSON-RPC/stdio transport, no tool registration, no tool schemas. main.go:37-45 constructs the struct and prints hard-coded exampleQueries. FEEDBACK.md flagged this from the prior attempt; it was not fixed.
top_findings.suggestion: Import mcp-go, register each query method as an MCP tool with an input schema, and serve over stdio in main().

top_findings.title: GetTeamStatistics computes goals for/against incorrectly for away matches
top_findings.evidence: server/server.go:88-90 unconditionally does stats.GoalsFor += m.HomeGoals and stats.GoalsAgainst += m.AwayGoals for every match, regardless of whether the team was home or away. For away matches the team's own goals are m.AwayGoals, so for/against are swapped. Contrast CalculateStandings (server.go:212-218) which correctly credits the away team with m.AwayGoals for / m.HomeGoals against. The W/L/D branch (server.go:92-108) is correct; only goals for/against is wrong. FEEDBACK.md explicitly flagged this; it was not fixed.
top_findings.suggestion: Inside the isAway branch, add m.AwayGoals to GoalsFor and m.HomeGoals to GoalsAgainst (mirror the home branch), matching the CalculateStandings logic.
